comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: I assumed, like a lot of people, that Niger was just Latin for black stamped onto the map from outside. The better accounts point somewhere else entirely: Berber and Tuareg words for river, gher, n igereouen, big rivers, gr n grwn, river of rivers. A name that means simply the river, repeated until it became two countries. The classical Nigris may not even be this river at all. Sources are listed in the description if you want to follow the trail. Where you live, is the big river named in your own language, or in someone else's?
